resources.string: Connection settings to the Omnis server.

The full URL to the Omnis server or Web Server which hosts an Omnis Web Server Plugin.\ \ For direct-to-Omnis connections it may be in the form:\ `http://192.168.1.100:<$serverport>`\ \ When using a Web Server plugin it may be in the form: `http://mysite.com`
If enabled, the app starts in offline mode.

Route to the form’s *.htm* file, from **Web Server URL**.\ \ So if you’re using the built in Omnis server, it will be of the form `/jschtml/myform.htm`\ \ If you are using a web server, it will be the remainder of the URL to get to the form e.g. `/omnisapps/myform.htm`.

The location of the Omnis Server: `<IP Address>:<Port>`.\ \ Only necessary if you are using a web server with the Omnis Web Server Plugin.\ \ If the Omnis App Server is running on the same machine as the web server, you can just supply a port here. E.g. `194.168.1.49:5912`
If you are using a web server plug-in to talk to Omnis, the route to this from **Web Server URL**.\ \ E.g. `/cgi-bin/omnisapi.dll`
Name of the offline form.\ \ **(Do not add *.HTM* extension!)**
Name of the App SCAF.\ \ This will generally be the same as your library name.\ This is _case-sensitive_ and must match the App Scaf (by default this is generally all lower-case)
If disabled, dates & times in offline mode are converted to/from UTC, as default.\ Enabling disables conversion.
Are you sure you wish to delete all offline resources?

URL to the RESTful interface to your Omnis server used for handling push notifications.\ \ For direct to Omnis connections, this will be of the form: `http://<ip address>:<$serverport>`\ \ When using a Web Server, this will be a URL to your RESTful web server plugin, suffixed with *"/ws/xxx"*\ Where _xxx_ is either:\ 1. **nnnn** (a port number)\ 2. **ipaddress_nnnn** (IP address and port number)\ 3. **serverpool_ipaddress_nnnn**\ \ E.g: *http://myserver.com/cgi-bin/nph-omnisrestcgi/ws/5912*

Allows you to specify the initial push notification Groups the device should be a member of.\ \ This takes a number, which should be a _bitmask_, where bit _N_ corresponds to the Group with _GroupMaskValue = N_, for the appropriate _App Group_.\ \ To calculate your bitmask, you need to sum **2^(N-1)** for all of the groups you wish to include, where N is the Group’s **GroupMaskValue**.
The name (including .db extension) of the local sqlite database to use.\ \ If you are bundling a prepopulated database with your app, its name should match what you set here.
If enabled, the webview can be debugged using Chrome DevTools
Require fingerprint or face unlock to access the application
Confirm your identity using your fingerprint or face to proceed
